scope: Audit and corrections of existing native character sheet; no new bitmap, actor, equipment or animation.

findings.before: An open action detail kept old resource/availability fields
findings.candidate: Revalidate from the authoritative snapshot while preserving detail scroll and focus

findings.before: Detail from the previous actor could remain visible
findings.candidate: Discard the old detail on actor switch

findings.before: A personal target masked the registered area radius
findings.candidate: Personal areas display their radius from the shared targeting geometry

findings.before: Short repertoire used 763 px and a second full feature panel
findings.candidate: One overview row, compact spell cards, readable trait buttons in the same panel

findings.before: Missing detailed saves were treated as confirmed
findings.candidate: Same confirmed/base distinction as the Summary

findings.before: Inventory always used the maximum window height
findings.candidate: Small bags adapt with enough useful height for take/store controls; large bags retain available height

findings.before: Selected tab had low visual distinction
findings.candidate: Native selected state and a gold underline/pendant

findings.before: Condition identifiers could appear in English
findings.candidate: Consistent Spanish display, mechanical identifiers unchanged

findings.before: Detail panel alpha .22 and centre offset by 22 px
findings.candidate: Opaque parchment (alpha 1), local input veil, host-relative centre and contact shadow; existing paper/frame reused

pipeline.reuse: Existing definitions, sprites, preview mask and materials retained; current validation is in the audit output
